class_label.morgan_city: inside Decatur or Hartselle city limits

tasks.text: Forward your mail (USPS change of address) and update your address with your bank, insurer and payroll — do this 2 weeks out.
Electric, water, sewer and gas are all on one Huntsville Utilities account at this kind of address — book the start date for the day after you take possession.
Inside Madison city limits you'll have two accounts: Huntsville Utilities for electricity, and the city utility for water and sewer.
Water and sewer out here are address-specific — some subdivisions sit on a water utility district, some on private wells and septic. Confirm with the seller who bills for water before you close.
Book your utility start date for the day after you take possession — the provider depends on where the address sits (see the utilities section below).
Arrange internet at the new address before you move in — availability differs street by street, and county addresses vary more than city ones.
Transfer or start homeowners/renters insurance effective the day you take possession. Alabama wind and hail coverage is worth a specific conversation with your agent.
Keep your closing disclosure or lease where you can reach it — you will need it for the tag office and for school enrollment.
Athens runs its own municipal utilities — one city account covers electric, water and sewer.
Decatur and Hartselle each run their own municipal utility, so electric, water and sewer come from the city rather than the county.
Garbage and recycling run on the city's collection day with city carts — check your day and the yard-waste and bulk rules.
Garbage and recycling come from the City of Madison on its own collection day — set up service with the city.
Unincorporated addresses here usually contract a private hauler rather than getting county collection — confirm which hauler covers your subdivision and what day it runs.
Confirm your hauling arrangement and any utility district for the exact address with the county.
Electricity across most of Madison County comes from Huntsville Utilities; a few fringe addresses sit with a rural co-op. Confirm at your address before switching anything on.
If there is gas at the address, it's Huntsville Utilities territory — schedule the account and any appliance connection together.
Put the collection calendar on the fridge in week one — yard waste, bulk pickup and holiday schedules all differ.
Get your library card — the Huntsville–Madison County Public Library system covers the whole county and gives you digital access on day one.
Garbage and recycling come from the City of Athens on the city's collection day.
Garbage and recycling are city-run here — check the city's collection day and cart rules.

Register vehicles and transfer titles at the Madison County licence office — bring the out-of-state title, proof of insurance and your new address. Alabama adds a one-time $15 title fee on top of annual registration, and out-of-state vehicles may need inspection.
Register vehicles and transfer titles at the licence office for your new county — bring the out-of-state title, proof of insurance and your address; out-of-state vehicles may need inspection.
Alabama registration is due in your birth month and renews every year. Confirm the registration and ad valorem total before you budget — it surprises out-of-state movers.
Exchange your out-of-state driver licence within 30 days of becoming a resident at an ALEA driver licence office — proof of residency and your prior licence are required.

Confirm which district — and which specific schools — serve your exact address before you sign anything. The three systems here are Huntsville City, Madison City and Madison County, and zones do not follow city-limit lines.
Enroll with Huntsville City Schools: proof of address, Alabama Certificate of Immunization, birth certificate and prior school records are the usual set.
Enroll with Madison City Schools — its own enrollment process and its own boundary map, separate from both other systems.
Enroll with Madison County Schools — this is the system for unincorporated addresses, including most new-build subdivisions outside the two cities.
Enrollment for your district: check the district site for the current document list and the enrollment window.
Check each school's current performance page on the state report card rather than relying on ratings sites.
Ask the district about capacity in your child's grade band — attendance lines shift when a school fills, and new subdivisions are where that happens first.
Enroll with Athens City Schools — a separate city district from Limestone County Schools. Check the address against the district's own zone map, because both systems exist in this county.
Enroll with Decatur City Schools or Hartselle City Schools — Morgan County has three public systems (the two cities plus Morgan County Schools), so the address decides which one.
Register to vote — Madison County residents register with the county board of registrars; Alabama requires photo ID at the polls.
Register to vote with the board of registrars for your new county — Alabama requires photo ID at the polls.
Update your vehicle registration and licence address first — both feed the voter-roll check.
Join the groups where newcomer questions actually get answered: the Newcomers Club of Greater Huntsville, and the subdivision Facebook group for your neighbourhood.
Find your neighbourhood association's covenant rules (HOA or voluntary association) before you paint, fence or park a trailer.
Alabama requires a current rabies vaccination; inside Huntsville city limits animal services licenses pets with the city.
Alabama requires a current rabies vaccination — keep the certificate with your records and check whether your city or county wants the animal licensed separately.
Send your vet records ahead of you — clinics here will ask for rabies dates before they will see a new patient.
Get your orders into the school system and the housing office early — Redstone assignments fill around the school year, not the PCS date.
Confirm your BAH rate from the official DoD table for your grade, dependents and the Huntsville MHA before you set a housing budget — do not work from an old posting.
Base access: non-DoD ID holders need a visitor pass and a sponsor; plan the first trip through the main gate with the paperwork in hand. Gate 9 on Rideout Road is the main visitor gate.
Off-post or on-post decision turns on school zone and commute more than on rent in most Redstone moves — run both through the calculators on this site.
